inventory_metadata.description: Exhaustive factual inventory of explainability (XAI) implementations, models, feature spaces, prediction APIs, and test coverage in the manufacturing/welding anomaly detection repository.

models_in_codebase.task: Supervised tabular welding anomaly classification (binary: normal vs anomaly)
models_in_codebase.input_type: Tabular fused features (sensor aggregates, log counts/flags, note presence)

models_in_codebase.task: Unsupervised tabular welding anomaly detection (fallback mode)
Supervised baseline RBF kernel support vector classification
Text sequence classification of serialised window summaries
models_in_codebase.input_type: Natural language serialisation of window statistics (window_to_text)

models_in_codebase.task: Contextualised transformer representation & self-attention extraction for operator notes
models_in_codebase.predict_proba_api: N/A (Encoder only; does not expose classification head or probability prediction API)

shap.name: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations)
unsupported_models: LogisticRegression (TreeExplainer requires tree ensemble; raises Exception)
SVC (TreeExplainer requires tree ensemble; raises Exception)
BertFaultDetector (TreeExplainer incompatible with PyTorch neural sequence model)
IsolationForest (Not wired in production pipeline AnomalyExplainer)
shap.feature_space: 40 tabular features (30 sensor aggregates + 9 log counts/flags + 1 note presence flag)
shap.explanation_scope: Local per-window explanation (with global feature attribution available via raw_shap aggregation)

output_schema.shap_drivers: list[dict(feature: str, shap: float, direction: str, magnitude: float, feature_value: float)]

existing_tests: tests/test_pipeline_quick.py: checks shap_text in pipeline payload

lime.name: LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations)
unsupported_models: BertFaultDetector (Tabular explainer incompatible with text sequence model)
lime.feature_space: 40 tabular features (30 sensor aggregates + 9 log counts/flags + 1 note presence flag)
lime.token_mapping: N/A (Tabular domain; regex condition parser _feature_from_condition maps discretised intervals back to bare feature names)
lime.prediction_api_used: detector.model.predict_proba (called during surrogate perturbation sampling) and detector.predict_proba(row)

output_schema.lime_drivers: list[dict(feature: str, condition: str, weight: float, direction: str, magnitude: float)]

attention.name: DistilBERT Self-Attention Heatmap
attention.underlying_method: Eager self-attention extraction from distilbert-base-uncased (averaged across all 6 layers and 12 heads)
unsupported_models: RandomForestClassifier (Tabular tree model possesses no attention mechanisms)
LogisticRegression (Linear baseline possesses no attention mechanisms)
BertFaultDetector (attention_explainer explicitly loads base distilbert-base-uncased, not fine-tuned classification weights in models/distilbert_fault)
attention.feature_space: Operator note word tokens (max 64 tokens per snippet)
attention.token_mapping: Subword wordpieces (##) merged back into whole words with max-pooled weights; [CLS], [SEP], [PAD] and pure-punctuation tokens dropped; weights min-max scaled to [0, 1]
attention.prediction_api_used: N/A (Operates solely on text strings; does not evaluate or produce anomaly probabilities, logits, or binary classification decisions)

shap_vs_lime.shared_sample_space: Multimodal fused tabular windows (identical row instances)

shap_vs_attention.reason: Disjoint feature spaces (40 tabular sensor/log features vs word tokens from natural-language notes), disjoint underlying models (RandomForestClassifier vs distilbert-base-uncased), and distinct predictive tasks (supervised tabular anomaly detection vs unsupervised contextual representation). Direct rank, vector, or distribution comparisons are mathematically invalid.

lime_vs_attention.reason: Disjoint feature spaces (40 tabular sensor/log features vs word tokens from natural-language notes), disjoint underlying models (RandomForestClassifier vs distilbert-base-uncased), and distinct predictive tasks. Direct rank or distribution comparisons are mathematically invalid.

RandomForest.attention: N/A (Tabular model has no attention mechanism)

LogisticRegression.shap: N/A (TreeExplainer does not support linear models)
LogisticRegression.attention: N/A (Linear model has no attention mechanism)

SVC.shap: N/A (TreeExplainer does not support kernel SVMs)
SVC.attention: N/A (Kernel model has no attention mechanism)

DistilBERT_FaultDetector.shap: N/A (TreeExplainer does not support transformer neural architectures)
DistilBERT_FaultDetector.lime: N/A (lime_explainer operates strictly on tabular feature vectors)
DistilBERT_FaultDetector.attention: N/A (attention_explainer is decoupled from the fine-tuned classification head)

data_modality_notes.tabular_sensor_and_logs: Present across all 1917 windows in data/processed/fused.parquet. Evaluated via SHAP and LIME under chronological holdout.
data_modality_notes.free_text_operator_notes: Present in 35 rows in data/raw/notes.csv. Not retained as a raw string column in fused.parquet (only binary 'has_note' flag is retained in tabular matrix). Evaluated independently via Attention explainer.
